note: Copy this to docs/glafka/guardrails.json in your project. Only `level` is required — everything else is a tweak on top of that level. Level 3 is used here because it is the first level that lets a project widen network.allowHosts. Level 2 already lets you widen exec.allow and secrets.keepEnv, but it has no network allow list. Run `glafka guardrails` after editing — it prints anything it refused.
